description: Send a concise progress report, discovery, or decision request to this child agent's bound parent while continuing the assigned task. This is not a terminal result, task completion, instruction, or authorization. The parent receives it at a model-request boundary.

propertyDescriptions.message: A concise update for the parent. Excess text is truncated to the configured message length. Do not include hidden reasoning, secrets, or an instruction that grants permissions.

guidance: Available only to a bound child agent, regardless of mode. Send only useful updates or questions; do not stream routine tool output. Use submit_task_result separately to finish the assigned task.
